_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Anjeun pamaké {player_id} dina kaulinan Liar's Dice nu diuluan ku {num_players} pamaké.
Aturan:
- Dina giliran anjeun, anjeun bisa milih:
  1) Nyieun tawaran anyar kalayan kuantitas nu leuwih luhur atawa nilai beungeut nu leuwih luhur (atawa duanana) batan tawaran ayeuna; contona '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Ngero tawaran panungtung ku ngetik '[Call]'.

Lamun anjeun ngero:
  - Lamun itungan sabenerna tina nilai beungeut éta di antara kabéh dadu kurang ti tawaran, pamaké nu panungtung ngaléngit hiji dadu.
  - Séjénna, pamaké nu ngero ngaléngit hiji dadu.
Pamaké nu nepi ka 0 dadu kaéléminasi. Pamaké nu nyésa panungtung meunang.

board.new_round:
Babak anyar - Dadu nu tinggal: {dice_summary}
Dadu anjeun ayeuna: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Pamaén {current_player_id} ngagero! Jumlah wajah {face_value} nu sabenerna nyaéta {count}, anu leuwih saeutik ti {quantity}.
Pamaén {loser_id} (pamaén pamungkas nu ngabid) éléh hiji dadu.
call.caller_loses:
Pamaén {current_player_id} ngagero! Jumlah wajah {face_value} nu sabenerna nyaéta {count}, anu leuwih loba atawa sarua jeung {quantity}.
Pamaén {loser_id} (pamaén nu ngagero) éléh hiji dadu.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aksi teu diakuan salaku '[Bid: X, Y]' atawa '[Call]' nu sah. Aksi nu dikirim: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Jumlah anyar {new_quantity} leuwih handap ti jumlah ayeuna {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nilai nominal anyar {new_face_value} leuwih handap tina ayeuna {current_face_value}.

message.eliminated_invalid: Pamaké {player_id} kaéléminasi ku lantaran gerakan salah.
